heading: personal lore
intro: the rough arc, then some details.

timeline.event: grew up in germany with 1-year stint near nashville, tennessee. encountering america and its bible belt probably played a role in many of my subsequent choices.
discovered effective altruism through animal rights groups on facebook.
started studying international relations in geneva. built ea group instead of attending lectures.
met a funder at a bioethics summer academy and subsequently dropped out of uni.
rebuilt effective altruism switzerland. ran 100s of workshops, coaching sessions and interviews with students, philanthropists and policymakers. and countless more meetups.
organized events to support the biological weapons convention. covid validated our focus on catastrophic risks. translated the momentum into a new vehicle.
co-founded the simon institute for longterm governance with max stauffer.
cofounded fractalgva after finally moving together with my wife after eight years of long-distance.

archive_intro: i have no mental imagery and am trying to get better at taking photos and sharing them. this is 10y on instagram (2014–2024), which i abandoned but exported all my data from.
